messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected 5823456789 - elevated 5xx + high p95 latency observed for hosted API and Dedicated pools in eu-west-2. Symptoms: control-plane telemetry backlog, proxy 502/504s, model-serving timeouts. Pager: @naomi. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-deg.
naomi: I'm on it, joining now. grabbing quick context and sigterm-safe steps. assigning kiran for platform mitigation.
kiran: joining TL;DR: large spike in MetricHouse (third-party metrics/ingest) 429s -> our observability exporters/backpressure causing control-plane write stalls -> downstream request queuing and timeouts. pulling traces.
sam: seeing dedicated pools in eu-west-2 with ~30% increased queue depth and retry amplification to model endpoints. Suggest immediate traffic shift for non-critical routes to eu-west-1 fallback.
naomi: mitigation plan: 1) shift portion of hosted traffic off eu-west-2 to eu-west-1 (gradual 70%) 2) scale up dedicated capacity in eu-west-1/eu-central-1 for hot paths 3) disable non-critical telemetry exports (traces/pprof) to reduce control-plane load 4) enable fail-fast circuit breaker to reduce retry storms and return clear 503 to clients. oncall: execute and report.
ev an: (support) customer impact: ~6 customers filed timeouts for chat & billing endpoints; internal alerting showing <1% of overall requests but higher for some tenants. WARN message to affected customers in 10m.
kiran: executing routing change now: ```./scripts/route-shift --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --pct 70```
incident-bot: command executed by kiran at 5823456825
sam: disabling trace export to MetricHouse: ```kubectl patch cm observability-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"trace_export":"off"}}'```
naomi: monitoring: p95 on shifted traffic dropping from ~1.8s -> ~350ms. cluster-wide 5xx rate down from 4.2% -> 0.9% after initial shift. keeping 10m observation window.
julie: CS update: alerted top-10 enterprise customers with mitigation note and ETA. no escalations to legal/security.
kiran: still seeing auth-proxy retry storms hitting control-plane due to queued telemetry; applying short-term knob: increase auth-proxy timeout to 8s and add jitter to backoff to reduce synchronized retries.
naomi: handoff/update: if this persists past 30m escalate to infra leads (@sam @kiran) for cross-region leader failover. I'll remain on until steady state. :white_check_mark:
ev an: logs snippet (sanitized): ```ERR proxy: upstream write failed: 429 Too Many Requests - MetricHouse ingestion throttled - backpressure on exporter queue```
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (partial). last update 5823456900. responders: naomi, kiran, sam, evan, julie. creating postmortem stub and paging owners for follow-up RCA.
